[spoiler=Shoot, no Wait Don't Shoot][b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Yesterday protesters gathered outside of the capital building with signs saying things like "Catch Hatzur yourself, stop using us" and "Conscription is bad, so why do we have it" as well as "WE HAVE THE RIGHT TO PROTEST, TO OWN GUNS, TO GAMBLE, TO GO OUTSIDE WITH OUT SEEING THE MILITARY WALKING AROUND, TO DO WHAT WE WANT, WHY'D YOU TAKE THAT AWAY!" in fact some even had signs saying "MACK SUCKS, WE WANT TONY BACK" or "B*TCH YOU TOOK FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND FREEDOM OF PRESS! WHATS NEXT FREEDOM TO LIVE!". "This was another ILEGAL protest, we probably would have handled it well" states Riot Control, John Castredumy, "If more people didn't start showing up as well. Also they started getting violent, they would push us into walls, punch us, and even hit us with signs or other weapons, then something happened, some one shot a gun, but not at us, at the crowed, and then another person fired back, and soon 28  protesters were dead, and 4 more were in critical condition, but that isn't counting the 5 officers killed as well, and 2 more officers were shot. Those numbers may seem like a lot, but it's really lucky because 1,203 rounds were fired, from many different guns including Ak-47s, Desert Eagles, Glocks, and 4 UZIs. These guns were all connected to a gun store in the former country of Eastornia-Kolionia." The new investigation branch, WVCIB (Western View Complete Ivestigation Bureau), a combination of all other branches of investigation, has found the shooters to be 29 men a part of Hatzur Zatsugi's group Guhui'Bernardio and of them 5 were Kolionian government officials. Due to the up coming election, this is not a good look for Mack Messiaon, but after interviewing many citizens out of every 3, 2 said that Mack could pull it together.[/spoiler]
